resources.string: No companion device set up yet. This is a one-time setup — after it, Auracast starts and stops on its own whenever the companion device comes and goes, with no screen needed on either device.
Bluetooth permission is required to find the companion device.
Set up. Auracast will now start automatically whenever %1$s is nearby — no further action needed here.
Already set up (association #%1$d) — Auracast runs automatically in the background.
Companion device is nearby — Auracast is broadcasting.
Companion device is not in range — Auracast is off.
